_note: Citizen visits. Triggers are in src/sim/visits.ts, keyed by id; everything else is here. Placeholders: {name}, {home}, {floor}; for the doctor and the delegate (F-018) also {cause} (the diagnosis cause's text), {what} (its short label), {amount} (what it costs) and {fix}; for the meal visits (#375) {crops}, the edible crops the hole doesn't grow yet. poor_meals and average_meals come when food variety over the last month has been poor, or average with nothing better (data/food.json visits); variety is left to them (skip), and their promise is kept once variety reaches the next rating. concerns: when the doctor (health) and a residents' delegate (happiness) come about a diagnosis cause. A cause counts once it drains health at all, or costs happiness problemPoints or more, and is fixed once it no longer drains health, or costs less than fixedPoints; skip leaves causes to other visits (noise_complaint) or to the doctor (holeHealth). They come once it has held holdDays: the first time about a cause only to tell you (the _note kinds), then, repeatDays after the last visit about it, asking for a promise (the _promise kinds). patienceDays 0: they wait until answered. greeter has no trigger: the tutorial's office step sends for one (the greet command, T-080) when nobody's waiting. grace (#434): no visit comes until afterLandingDays after the hole was founded, and until earlyDays only earlyAtOnce waits at a time. fixRooms (on a visit, or in concerns by cause key): the rooms that fix what it's about; the visit waits until one of them is unlocked in this hole and, in the guided tutorial, its step has shown it (left out: nothing to wait for, as for a corridor or a bulkhead). Voices (#433): a notable speaks in the voice of the first of their traits listed in voices.byTrait (blunt, worried or cheerful), else plainly: a visit's voices hold its text in each voice, falling back to text. {say} is what the doctor or the delegate says about the cause (concerns.say, by cause key; {Say} capitalised), falling back to the cause's own text; the numbers and the fix go in the visit's aside, shown small under what they say.

visits.title: Noise complaint
visits.text: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}. "Nobody in our block has slept properly for months. Something has to give."

voices.blunt: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}, and gets straight to it. "It's too loud to sleep down there. Something has to give."
voices.worried: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}. "The children can't sleep, and neither can we. I'm afraid someone's going to snap."
voices.cheerful: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}, yawning. "We've learned to sleep through a lot down here, but not this. Any chance of a little quiet?"

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting and went home, where it's still too loud to nap. The {home} is grumbling.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Move the noise away or buffer it with a corridor.

kept.message: {name} thanks you: the {home} is sleeping again.

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise about the noise, and says it loudly, which feels pointed.

choices.label: Enact quiet hours
choices.hint: Ordinance: noise felt at home halved; noisy rooms 5% slower.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: "That noise is the sound of air."

visits.title: Room demand: a clinic
visits.text: {name} speaks for the colonists: "Someone is going to get hurt down here, and there's nowhere to go. We need a clinic."

voices.blunt: {name} speaks for the colonists. "Someone's going to get hurt down here, and there's nowhere to take them. Build a clinic."
voices.worried: {name} speaks for the colonists. "Every time someone slips on a ladder I hold my breath. If anyone gets badly hurt, there's nowhere to go. We need a clinic."
voices.cheerful: {name} speaks for the colonists. "We've been lucky so far, and I'd love it to stay that way. A clinic would put everyone's mind at rest."

ignored.message: {name} left the office without an answer, and people are asking why.

choices.label: You'll have one within 5 months
choices.hint: Build a clinic (needs brick, metal and electronics).

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word, and handing out bandages.

choices.label: Not yet: there are bigger priorities
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: The doctor's report
visits.text: {name} has been keeping an eye on everyone's health. "{Say}. I thought you should know."

voices.blunt: {name} doesn't bother sitting down. "{Say}. It's making people ill, and it won't sort itself out."
voices.worried: {name} hovers in the doorway. "I don't want to alarm anyone, but {say}. I've been losing sleep over it."
voices.cheerful: {name} drops in, the smile slipping a little. "Nothing dramatic, but {say}. Worth a look when you can."

choices.label: Noted, thank you
choices.hint: Nothing more for now. If it lasts, they'll be back to ask you to fix it.

visits.title: The doctor wants it fixed
visits.text: {name} is back. "{Say}, still. Can you sort it out?"

voices.blunt: {name} is back, and not pleased. "{Say}. Still. I told you last time. Will you fix it or not?"
voices.worried: {name} is back, looking tired. "It's no better: {say}. Please, can something be done?"
voices.cheerful: {name} is back, trying to keep it light. "So: {say}, still. Shall we fix it together?"

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. Word is the doctor's worried and you weren't listening.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Kept: loyalty and happiness. Broken: loyalty.

kept.message: {name} thanks you for fixing it ({what}): one less thing for the doctor to worry about.

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to fix it ({what}).

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: A word from the residents
visits.text: {name} speaks for the residents. "{Say}. People wanted you to hear it from us."

voices.blunt: {name} speaks for the residents, and doesn't soften it. "{Say}. People are fed up."
voices.worried: {name} speaks for the residents, quietly. "People are anxious: {say}. I said I'd let you know."
voices.cheerful: {name} brings word from the residents. "Everyone's mostly fine, honestly, but {say}. Thought you'd want to know."

choices.label: Noted, thank you
choices.hint: Nothing more for now. If it lasts, they'll be back to ask you to fix it.

visits.title: The residents want it fixed
visits.text: {name} is back for the residents. "{Say}, still. Will you do something about it?"

voices.blunt: {name} is back for the residents, arms folded. "{Say}. Still. They want an answer this time."
voices.worried: {name} is back for the residents. "It hasn't changed: {say}. People are starting to lose heart."
voices.cheerful: {name} is back for the residents, still smiling, just. "{Say}, still. Make my day and tell me it's on the list?"

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. The residents feel ignored, and they're saying so over dinner.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Kept: loyalty and happiness. Broken: loyalty.

kept.message: {name} thanks you, for the residents, for fixing it ({what}).

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it ({what}).

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: The same meal again
visits.text: {name} sets a tray down on your desk. "Ration paste, or one crop boiled every way there is. Two kinds of food would already be a real change. We could grow {crops}."

voices.blunt: {name} drops a tray on your desk. "The same slop, every meal. People are sick of it. We could grow {crops}."
voices.worried: {name} sets a tray down on your desk. "People are leaving half their plates. It's the same meal, over and over. We could grow {crops}."
voices.cheerful: {name} sets a tray down with a flourish. "Today's special: the same as yesterday's. We could grow {crops}, you know."

visits.aside: A galley mixes up to four kinds of food into one meal: two kinds make it average, not poor.

ignored.message: {name} left the office without an answer. The galley crew is grumbling.

choices.label: More kinds of food within 4 months
choices.hint: Grow a second crop (or more), and keep both stocked: meals with two kinds are average, not poor.

kept.message: {name} brought you a plate with two kinds of food on it. Word is the galley's improving.

broken.message: Still the same meal. {name} is telling everyone you forgot about the galley.

choices.label: Food is food
choices.hint: "There are holes on Mars with less." Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: A better table
visits.text: {name} is here from the galley crew. "Two kinds of food in every meal keeps us going, but it could be a proper meal, the kind people look forward to. We could grow {crops}."

voices.blunt: {name} is here from the galley crew. "Dinner's fine. Just fine. People want more than fine. We could grow {crops}."
voices.worried: {name} is here from the galley crew. "Nobody's complaining, exactly, but dinner's become a chore. We could grow {crops}."
voices.cheerful: {name} is here from the galley crew, full of plans. "Imagine three or four kinds on one plate! We could grow {crops}."

visits.aside: Meals with three kinds of food are good, with four great.

ignored.message: {name} left the office without an answer. The galley crew is grumbling.

choices.label: Three or four kinds within 4 months
choices.hint: Grow more crops, and keep their stocks up: meals with three kinds are good, with four great.

kept.message: Good meals in the galley at last. {name} says people linger over dinner now.

broken.message: Still the same two things on every plate. {name} says you broke your word.

choices.label: Food is food
choices.hint: "There are holes on Mars with less." Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: Just saying hi
visits.text: {name} pokes their head round the door. "Don't mind me, I only wanted to say hello. It's good to have someone in charge down here."

voices.blunt: {name} pokes their head round the door. "Just saying hello. Glad someone's in charge down here."
voices.worried: {name} knocks twice before coming in. "Sorry, I hope I'm not interrupting. I only wanted to say hello. It's a comfort, having someone in charge."
voices.cheerful: {name} bounds in. "Hello! I just wanted to meet the person in charge. It's good to have you down here."

choices.label: Nice to meet you
choices.hint: They'll be back when something's on their mind.
